Diego (Eng Manager): thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-ups: can leadership confirm Q3 headcount targets by org, whether there's any hiring pause, and what the plan is for the eng-platform/team merges?
Emma (CEO): short answers — no company-wide hiring freeze; targeted pauses in low-priority IC roles. Q3 net hiring target ~+22 FTEs, prioritized on infra, inference runtime, and customer success. details below.
Tom (VP Eng): To add — eng-platform and eng-runtime will merge some pods into a runtime platform org; this is mostly reporting and pooling of infra engineers; no mass layoffs, reassignments only as hires ramp.
Diego (Eng Manager): can we get numbers per org? engineering buckets are helpful.
Emma (CEO): sure. high level plan: 
```
Q3 hires (net):
- Eng infra/Runtime: +9
- Product/Design: +4
- Cust Success & Sales Eng: +5
- Research/Applied ML: +2
- People Ops & Recruiting: +2
```
Priya (Hiring Lead): recruiting note — hiring velocity will be staged; we will prioritize reqs with hiring manager sign-off and clear ramp plans. Expect 2-week priority reviews.
Marta (People Ops): Compensation hold? no. Offers continue; growth bands updated last quarter.
Diego (Eng Manager): what about manager/IC ratio concerns? will there be manager hiring or more ICs?
Tom (VP Eng): majority are ICs for capacity, with 3-4 senior manager hires planned to support new product lanes. We're balancing IC:SWE to keep spans healthy.
Diego (Eng Manager): ok, timeline for org merge?
Tom (VP Eng): beginning of August we'll publish org maps and new reporting lines; staggered rollouts, expects minimal disruption.
Emma (CEO): we will hold a dedicated AMA next Friday to walk through org maps and hiring prioritization. I'll post the invite.
All-Hands Bot: Recording saved: https://redwood.company/recordings/all-hands-200501.json :white_check_mark:
Priya (Hiring Lead): I'll share the hiring roadmap doc and open a comments thread in People Ops channel: https://redwood.company/hiring-roadmap
Diego (Eng Manager): thanks — appreciate the clarity. tagging folks who asked during the meeting. :thumbsup:
Marta (People Ops): if you have role-specific questions, ping me directly or drop requests in #people-ops; we'll run FAQ and hiring playbook updates tomorrow.
